title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to officially launch Spyglass, moving this powerful tool from beta to general availability for all users.

title: Enhanced File Management in Your Editor
summary: Take full control of your images and files within the editor, with seamless management, easy uploads, convenient downloads, and flexible display options.

title: Our New Public Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our brand new public roadmap page, where you can easily track our recently shipped features, see what's coming next, and discover our exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Experience a significant upgrade to your task management with our redesigned checkboxes, now larger, easier to click, and fully draggable for effortless organization.

title: Seamless Team Editing
summary: Experience effortless teamwork with our newly refined editor, now featuring clearer collaboration indicators for a more seamless co-editing experience.

title: Enhanced Collaboration & Shared Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on shared ideas and quests, empowering a more connected and efficient teamwork experience.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: We're thrilled to introduce comprehensive support for international languages, allowing users worldwide to enjoy Noeko.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: We're making Noeko's codebase open source, giving you maximum control and direct involvement in our project's growth, and ensuring full transparency.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Explore your knowledge base with unprecedented clarity by applying dynamic filters for tags, time, and shared items to your personalized visual overview, making it an indispensable tool for discovery and workflow.

title: Advanced Search & Saved Compendiums
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint specific information within your knowledge base by applying powerful new filters and saving your customized search results as a personal Compendium.

title: Dynamic Note Views
summary: We're introducing dynamic new ways to view and interact with your connected content, making it effortless to structure your thoughts and visualize information.

title: Noeko Unleashed: New Hosting Options & Tailored Plans
summary: Experience unparalleled flexibility and power with Noeko's upcoming self-hosted and cloud-hosted editions, offering diverse plans to perfectly match your individual or team's requirements.

title: Elevated Aesthetics: New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: Discover a refreshed visual experience with improved existing themes and an exciting collection of brand-new, stunning styles to personalize your workspace.

title: Smarter Time-of-Day Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your welcome experience by ensuring our greetings perfectly match the time of day, making every interaction feel more personal and accurate.

title: Enhanced Tag Control: Manage Items Directly
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items with new direct actions, allowing you to unapply tags, delete content, or view details without ever leaving the tag list.

title: Connect More Content Types
summary: Get ready to seamlessly integrate a wider range of information, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, directly into your workflow to build a richer knowledge base.
